children: Delivery Hero's robust second-quarter results are unlikely to drive an upgrade to Uber's bid, Stifel's Clement Genelot writes in a note. The German food-delivery company showed its ability to revive growth across all its regions, he says. Additionally, the "reinvestment plan in the Middle East is less painful than feared, with Talabat [DH's Middle East subsidiary] having recently upgraded its own full-year 2026 guidance on growth," he notes. However, no offer upgrade should be expected after the company's strong results, he says.(najat.kantouar@wsj.com)
